chapter.heading: An Invocation and a DoxologyTo the Chief Musician. On stringed instruments. A Psalm. A Song.
chapter.v:
God be
merciful to us and bless us,And cause His face to shine upon us,Selah [Ex. 12:12; Jer.] [Jer. 9:25, 26; Ezek. 29:1–30:19; Joel 3:19 b Ps. 18:10; 104:3; Matt. 26:64; Rev. 1:7]

That Your
way may be known on earth,Your salvation among all nations. [Judg. 7:22;]

Let the
peoples praise You, O God;Let all the peoples praise You. [1 Chr. 10:13; Is. 8:19; 47:12; Dan. 2:2]

Oh, let
the nations be glad and sing for joy!For You shall judge the people righteously,And govern the nations on earth.Selah [Is. 20:4; Jer. 46:26; Ezek. 29:19]

Let the
peoples praise You, O God;Let all the peoples praise You. [Is. 50:2; Jer. 51:36; Ezek. 30:12]

Then the
earth shall yield her increase;God, our own God, shall bless us. [2 Kin. 19:24]

God shall
bless us,And all the ends of the earth shall fear Him.
